card.name: Words in fixed label sentences
card.fires_on: A word inside a stock label sentence where a conditional or contact phrase is mid-way, such as 'unusual' in 'In the unusual case that', 'treatment' in 'center on the treatment of any overdose', or 'is' in 'when pregnancy is detected'.

modes.label: In the unusual case
modes.description: The word 'unusual' in the pregnancy-hypertension sentence 'In the unusual case that there is no appropriate alternative'.
modes.example: In the<< unusual>> case that there is no appropriate alternative to

modes.label: Overdose contact sentence
modes.description: The word 'treatment' in the poison control center sentence about overdose.
modes.example: The physician should consider contacting a poison control center on the<< treatment>> of any overdose.

modes.label: Is before a planned or detected event
modes.description: The verb 'is' right after a subject like discontinuation or pregnancy, before 'planned' or 'detected'.

card.plain: It fires on a single word inside well-worn warning sentences from drug labels, such as the pregnancy and overdose statements.
